notes.title: Summit Demo Developer Live Stream
notes.notes:
Get a first look at a brand-new 2D Metroidvania world featuring a unique mountain-themed setting, plenty of interesting mechanics and of course potential for a ton of exploration.

Dominik, the developer of Summit, will provide interesting facts about developing a large 2D Metroidvania in Unity and how to manage a project of that scope completely on his own, including programming, graphics, level design, music etc.

The Summit demo features over 5 hours of gameplay and exploring the world and can be downloaded at any time from the Summit Steam page.
